properties.Caption: Customer Retention Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Customer Retention Overview page provides insights into customer retention metrics, helping to analyze customer loyalty and retention trends.

properties.Caption: Financial Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Financial Overview provides a snapshot of the organization's financial health and performance. This page displays key performance indicators that give stakeholders a clear view of revenue, profitability, and financial stability.

properties.Caption: Income Statement by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Income Statement by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Income Statement by Month report provides a month-to-month comparative view of the net change for income statement accounts.

properties.Caption: Balance Sheet by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Balance Sheet by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Balance Sheet by Month report provides a month-to-month comparative view of the balance at date for balance sheet accounts.

properties.Caption: Budget Comparison (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Budget Comparison report presents a month-to-month analysis of Net Change against Budget Amounts for both Balance Sheet and Income Statement accounts. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics, providing a clear view of how actual performance compares to budgeted targets.

properties.Caption: Liquidity KPIs (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Liquidity KPIs report offers insights into three key metrics: Current Ratio, Quick Ratio, and Cash Ratio. Visualizing these metrics over time, the report makes it easy to track trends and assess the company’s liquidity position.

properties.Caption: Profitability (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Profitability report highlights Gross Profit and Net Profit, visualizing these metrics over time. It also provides detailed insights into net margins, gross profit margins, and the underlying revenue, cost and expense figures that drive them.

properties.Caption: Liabilities (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Liabilities report provides a snapshot of liability account balances as of a specific date. It also highlights key performance metrics influenced by liabilities, such as the Debt Ratio and Debt-to-Equity Ratio.

properties.Caption: EBITDA (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The EBITDA report focuses on two key profitability metrics: EBITDA and EBIT. These figures are visualized over time to reveal trends, while Operating Revenue and Operating Expenses are also highlighted to provide supporting context for both measures.

properties.Caption: Average Collection Period (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Average Collection Period report analyses trends in the average collection period over time. It includes supporting details such as the Number of Days, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Receivable (Average) to provide context and enhance the analysis.

properties.Caption: Aged Receivables (Back Dating) (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Aged Receivable Back Dating report categorizes customer balances into aging buckets. It offers flexibility with filters for different payment terms, aging dates, and custom aging bucket sizes.

properties.Caption: Aged Payables (Back Dating) (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Aged Payables Back Dating report categorizes vendor balances into aging buckets. It offers flexibility with filters for different payment terms, aging dates, and custom aging bucket sizes.

properties.Caption: General Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The General Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to the general ledger.

properties.Caption: Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to Vendor Ledger and Detailed Vendor Ledger.

properties.Caption: Detailed Cust. Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Detailed Cust. Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Detailed Customer Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to Customer Ledger and Detailed Customer Sub Ledger.

properties.Caption: Sales Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Overview provides a comprehensive view of sales performance, offering insights into metrics such as Total Sales, Gross Profit Margin, Number of New Customers, and top-performing customers and salespeople.

properties.Caption: Daily Sales (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Daily Sales report offers a detailed analysis of sales amounts by weekday. The tabular report highlights trends by using conditional formatting to display figures in a gradient from low to high.

properties.Caption: Sales Moving Average (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Moving Average report visualizes the 30-day moving average of sales amounts over time. This helps identify trends by smoothing out fluctuations and highlighting overall patterns.

properties.Caption: Sales Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Moving Annual Total report provides a rolling 12-month view of sales figures, tracking the current year to the previous year's performance.

properties.Caption: Sales Period-Over-Period (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Period Over Period report compares sales performance across different periods, such as month-over-month or year-over-year.

properties.Caption: Sales Month-To-Date (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Month-to-Date report tracks the accumulation of sales amounts throughout the current month, providing insights into progress and performance up to the present date.

properties.Caption: Sales by Item (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Item report breaks down sales performance by item category, highlighting metrics such as Sales Amount, Gross Profit Margin, and Gross Profit as a Percent of the Grand Total. This report provides detailed insights into which categories and items are driving revenue and profitability.

properties.Caption: Sales by Customer (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Customer report breaks down sales performance highlighting key metrics such as Sales Amount, Cost Amount, Gross Profit and Gross Profit Margin by customer. This report provides detailed insights into which customer and items driving revenue and profitability.

properties.Caption: Sales by Salesperson (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Salesperson report breaks down salesperson performance by customer and item. Highlighting metrics such as Sales Amount, Sales Quantity, Gross Profit and Gross Profit Margin.

properties.Caption: Sales Actual vs. Budget (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Actual vs. Budget (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Actual vs. Budget report provides a comparative analysis of sales to budget amounts/quantities. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics that provide a clear view of actual performance compared to budgeted targets.

properties.Caption: Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount
properties.AboutText: The Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount report provides a comparative analysis of sales amounts to budget amount. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics that provide a clear view of actual performance compared to budgeted targets.

properties.Caption: Daily Purchases (Power BI)
